verdict.rationale: OCI offers a full-featured CLI and REST APIs/SDKs plus a Terraform provider, all of which support headless/CI automation, and community evidence confirms real-world CI usage (Jenkins CI on OCI instances) working reliably via SSH/API. Missing for 10: no explicit CI/CD pipeline integration docs (e.g., GitHub Actions, dedicated CI examples) or first-party automation-specific guidance beyond CLI/SDK/Terraform.
